name: Sika AnchorFix-1
paste:
SIKA ANCHORFIX®-1: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika AnchorFix®-1, April 2023, Version 02.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/j/sika_anchorfix_-1.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika AnchorFix®-1 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.03).
1.2 Product description. Solvent and styrene free based, two-component polyester anchoring adhesive.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. As a fast curing anchoring adhesive for all grades of:
    - Rebars / reinforcing steel
    - Threaded rods
    - Bolts and special fastening systems
    - Concrete
    - Hollow and solid masonry
    - Hard natural stone*
    - Solid rock*
    * These substrates may vary greatly, in particular with regard to strength, composition and porosity. Therefore, for each application the suitability of Sika AnchorFix®-1 Adhesive must be tested by first applying Sika AnchorFix®-1 Adhesive only to a sample area. Check in particular bond strength, surface staining and discolouration.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika AnchorFix®-1
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Fast curing styrene free chemical anchoring adhesive
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates.
    - Complies to NCC 2019 reference to AS 5216:2018 - Design of post-installed and cast-in fastenings in concrete
    - Injection system for use in masonry according to ETAG 029, ETA-12/0227, Declaration of Performance 020403010010000001 5034408, certified by notified product certification body 0679, certificate of constancy of performance 0679-DPD-0777, and provided with the CE marking
    - Bonded injection type anchor for non cracked concrete according to ETAG 001 annex 1 and 5, ETA- 13/0720, Declaration of Performance 020403010010000001 5034408, certified by notified product certification body 1020, certificate of constancy of performance 1020-CPD-090-029816, and provided with the CE marking.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS 5216:2018: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - NCC 2019: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - ETA-12/0227: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - ETAG 029: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - ETAG 001: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - ASTM D 695: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Compressive strength (p.2); Technical Information > Modulus of elasticity in compression (p.2).
    - ASTM D 790: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Tensile strength in flexure (p.2).
    - ASTM D 638: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Modulus of elasticity in tension (p.2); Technical Information > Tensile strength (p.2).
    - DIN EN ISO 6721-1: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Glass transition temperature (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Fast curing
    - Standard guns can be used
    - Can be used at low temperatures
    - High load capacity
    - ETA Approval available
    - Non-sag, even overhead
    - Styrene-free
    - Low odour
    - Low wastage
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Density: ~1.63 kg/l (component A+B mixed)
2.6 Colour.
    | Component A: | white |
    | Component B: | black |
    | Component A+B mixed: | light grey |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
2.7 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Compressive strength: ~60 N/mm²(7 days, +20 °C) (ASTM D 695)
    - Modulus of elasticity in compression: ~3 500 N/mm²(7 days, +20 °C) (ASTM D 695)
    - Tensile strength in flexure: ~28 N/mm²(7 days, +20 °C) (ASTM D 790)
    - Tensile strength: ~12 N/mm²(7 days, +20 °C) (ASTM D 638)
    - Modulus of elasticity in tension: ~4 500 N/mm²(7 days, +20 °C) (ASTM D 638)
    - Glass transition temperature: +60 °C (DIN EN ISO 6721-1)
    - Design considerations: For details about adhesive anchoring design refer to the separate documentation provided: “Technical Documentation Sika AnchorFix®-1” Ref: 870 43 01
2.8 Temperature resistance.
    | Long term | +50 °C |
    | Short term (1–2 hours) | +80 °C |
2.9 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Shelf life: 12 months from date of production; All Sika AnchorFix®-1 cartridges have the expiry date printed on the label.
    - Storage conditions: Stored properly in original, unopened, sealed and undamaged packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +25 °C. Protect from direct sunlight.
2.10 Packaging.
    | 300 ml standard cartridge | 12 cartridges per box |
    | pallet: 75 boxes |
    | 550 ml standard cartridge | Project quantities availble on re- |
    | quest. Lead times apply. |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.03) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality.
    - Mortar and concrete must be at the required strength. No need to be 28 days old.
    - Substrate strength (concrete, masonry, natural stone) must be verified.
    - Pull-out tests must be carried out if the substrate strength is unknown.
    - The anchor hole must always be clean, dry, free from oil and grease etc.
    - Loose particles must be removed from the holes.
    - Threaded rods and rebars have to be cleaned thoroughly from any oil, grease or any other substances and particles such as dirt etc.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.03) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: Component A : component B = 10 : 1 by volume
    - Layer thickness: 3 mm max.
    - Sag flow: Non-sag, even overhead
4.3 Curing time.
    | Temperature | Open time - Tgel | Curing time - Tcur |
    | +30 °C | 4 minutes | 35 minutes |
    | +25 °C – +30 °C | 4 minutes | 40 minutes |
    | +20 °C – +25 °C | 5 minutes | 50 minutes |
    | +10 °C – +20 °C | 6 minutes | 85 minutes |
    | +5 °C – +10 °C | 10 minutes | 145 minutes |
    | +5 °C | 18 minutes | 145 minutes |
    | –10 °C ¹ ² | 30 minutes | 24 hours |
    Note printed: 1 Minimum cartridge temperature: +5 °C 2 This application is not covered by the scope of the product ETA or any other approval.
4.4 Mixing.
    - Getting the cartridge ready: 300 ml / 550 ml 1. Unscrew the cap 2. Cut the film 3. Screw on the static mixer 4. Place the cartridge into the gun and start application
    - When the work is interrupted the static mixer can remain on the cartridge after the gun pressure has been relieved. If the resin has hardened in the nozzle when work is resumed, a new nozzle must be attached.
4.5 Application method / tools.
    - Anchors in solid masonry / concrete Drilling of hole with an electric drill to the diameter and depth required. Drill hole diameter must be in accordance with anchor size. The drill hole must be cleaned with a blow pump or by compressed air, starting from the bottom of the hole. (at least 2x) Important: use oil-free compressors. The drill hole must be thoroughly cleaned with the special steel brush (brush at least 2x). The diameter of the brush must be larger than the diameter of the drill hole. The drill hole must be cleaned with a blow pump or by compressed air, starting from the bottom of the hole. (at least 2x) Important: use oil-free compressors. The drill hole must be thoroughly cleaned with the special steel brush (brush at least 2x). The diameter of the brush must be larger than the diameter of the drill hole. The drill hole must be cleaned with a blow pump or by compressed air, starting from the bottom of the hole. (at least 2x) Important: use oil-free compressors. Pump approx. twice until both parts come out uniformly. Do not use this material. Release the gun pressure and clean the cartridge opening with a cloth. Inject the adhesive into the hole, starting from the bottom, while slowly drawing back the static mixer.In any case avoid entrapping air. For deep holes extension tubing can be used. Insert the anchor with a rotary motion into the filled drill hole. Some adhesive must come out of the hole. Important: the anchor must be placed within the open time. During the resin hardening time the anchor must not be moved or loaded. Wash tools immediately with Sika® Colma Cleaner. Wash hands and skin thoroughly with warm soap water.
    - Anchors in hollow blocks Drilling of hole with an electric drill to the diameter and depth required. Drill hole diameter must be in accordance with anchor-and perforated sleeve size. Note: with hollow material do not use rotary hammer drills. The drill hole must be thoroughly cleaned with a round brush (brush at least 1x). The diameter of the brush must be larger than the diameter of the drill hole. The drill hole must be cleaned after each cleaning step with a blow pump or by compressed air, starting from the bottom of the hole (pump at least 1x). Important: use oil-free compressors. Insert perforated sleeve completely into the drill hole. Pump approx. twice until both parts come out uniformly. Do not use this material. Release the gun pressure and clean the cartridge opening with a cloth. Inject the adhesive into the perforated sleeve, starting from the bottom, while slowly drawing back the static mixer. In any case avoid entrapping air. Close the cap from the perforated sleeve to avoid some escape of the resin during entering the steel rod. Insert the anchor with a rotary motion into the filled perforated sleeve. Use the adequate steel rod size. Important: the anchor must be placed within the open time. During the resin hardening time the anchor must not be moved or loaded. Wash tools immediately with Sika® Colma Cleaner. Wash hands and skin thoroughly with warm soap water.
4.6 Cleaning of equipment. Clean tools and application equipment with Sika® Colma Cleaner immediately after use. Hardened / cured material can only be mechanically removed.
4.7 Further information.
    - For design details, please refer to the separate documentation provided:
    - Technical Documentation Sika AnchorFix®-1 Ref: 870 43 01

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Material temperature. Sika AnchorFix®-1 must be at a temperature of between +5 °C and +40 °C for application.
5.3 Ambient air temperature. -10 °C min. / +40 °C max.
5.4 Dew point. Beware of condensation. Substrate temperature during application must be at least 3 °C above dew point.
5.5 Substrate temperature. -10 °C min. / +40 °C max.
5.6 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - * These substrates may vary greatly, in particular with regard to strength, composition and porosity. Therefore, for each application the suitability of Sika AnchorFix®-1 Adhesive must be tested by first applying Sika AnchorFix®-1 Adhesive only to a sample area. Check in particular bond strength, surface staining and discolouration.
5.7 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Compressive strength: ~60 N/mm²(7 days, +20 °C) (ASTM D 695)
    - Modulus of elasticity in compression: ~3 500 N/mm²(7 days, +20 °C) (ASTM D 695)
    - Tensile strength in flexure: ~28 N/mm²(7 days, +20 °C) (ASTM D 790)
    - Tensile strength: ~12 N/mm²(7 days, +20 °C) (ASTM D 638)
    - Modulus of elasticity in tension: ~4 500 N/mm²(7 days, +20 °C) (ASTM D 638)
    - Glass transition temperature: +60 °C (DIN EN ISO 6721-1)
5.8 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.9 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika AnchorFix®-1, April 2023, Version 02.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/j/sika_anchorfix_-1.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika AnchorFix®-1 Part B, version 22/04/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/4/sds-sika-anchorfix-1partb.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sika AnchorFix-1 (B), version 06/09/2024, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/o/MSDS%20Sika%20Anchorfix-1%20(B)%20GHS7.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika AnchorFix®-1 Part A, version 04/02/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/v/sds-sika-anchorfix-1parta.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
